questions.stem: In a discussion on the biochemical properties of serine proteases, a molecular biologist outlines several characteristics common to this class of enzymes. Serine proteases play critical roles in various physiological processes, including digestion and coagulation. Which of the following features is universally found in all serine proteases?
questions.stemHtml: In a discussion on the biochemical properties of serine proteases, a molecular biologist outlines several characteristics common to this class of enzymes. Serine proteases play critical roles in various physiological processes, including digestion and coagulation. Which of the following features is universally found in all serine proteases?

options.label: A
options.text: Trypsin is activated by the removal of a hexapeptide from C-terminal end

options.label: B
options.text: α 2-Macroglobulin is the major serine protease inhibitor of plasma

options.label: C
options.text: Chymotrypsin acts on peptide bonds in which the amino acid C-terminal to the bond is a tryptophan, tyrosine, phenylalanine.

options.label: D
options.text: Presence of Ser-His-Asp catalytic triad at the active site
